source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted calendar dialog contains a native icon button with the close-button class and Fluent attributes for its accessible label and title. Click routing calls close(), and the dialog listens for cancel; close also clears loading/reload/data/show-promise state. The current test exercises clicking the title-bar close button and Escape cancellation. Scoped accessibility recommendation: preserve this actual control, label and close lifecycle when changing its icon styling; the test does not establish focus restoration or screen-reader output. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Calendar close-button geometry must retain a named native button
